records.text: The Christian Post reported in 2011 that Frank Turek had consulted for Bank of America on and off for about 15 years, mainly on leadership and team-building programs.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: Check out this headline following Frank Turek's ouster tells us this is the Christian Post reporting back in 2011 that he was the Christian consultant and was fired over his book on gay marriage. The article tells us that just months after being fired from Cisco Systems in California over an anti-gay marriage book, Christian consultant. ... And Dr. Frank Turek was also given the boot from Bank of America. Turek (Frank Turek) was doing work on and off for Bank of America for about 15 years, mainly conducting leadership and team building programs.

verification.notes: The cited Christian Post article, published September 4, 2011, says Frank Turek worked on and off for Bank of America for about 15 years, mainly conducting leadership and team-building programs.
